extra.message: The user-controlled packet_ref parameter is joined to BASE_EXPORT_DIR without containment validation and then read with read_text(). Absolute paths or ../ components allow an internal-token holder to read arbitrary server files.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: The URL from request.GET['url'] is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen(). An internal-token holder can request loopback, private-network, or cloud-metadata URLs and read a response preview.
pickle.loads() deserializes bytes taken from the HTTP request body or blob query parameter. A crafted pickle can execute arbitrary Python code during deserialization.

The expr query parameter is evaluated as Python code. Supplying an empty __builtins__ dictionary is not a secure sandbox because Python object-graph traversal can recover dangerous classes and achieve arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code

extra.message: The fragment query parameter is concatenated into Jinja2 template source and rendered. An attacker with the internal token can inject template expressions and traverse Jinja/Python objects to execute server-side code.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: The user-controlled name parameter determines the destination passed to write_bytes() without verifying that it remains inside BASE_EXPORT_DIR. Absolute paths or traversal sequences permit arbitrary file creation or overwrite with the request body.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

extra.message: The host query parameter is concatenated into a shell command passed to os.system(). Shell metacharacters allow an internal-token holder to execute arbitrary operating-system commands.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in an OS Command

extra.message: An attacker-controlled JSON object is passed directly to MongoDB find_one() as its query filter. MongoDB operators such as $ne, $regex, and $where can alter query semantics, bypass intended matching, or trigger expensive operations.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic

extra.message: The endpoint returns the Django settings module and absolute private-export directory. This discloses internal filesystem and application-layout information that assists exploitation of the file traversal endpoints.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Attacker-controlled request XML is parsed with DTD loading, external entity resolution, and network access enabled. Crafted entities can read local files, make internal network requests, or cause resource exhaustion.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The employee detail template unconditionally renders home address, national-ID digits, and bank-account digits. employees.services.visible_employees_for() permits payroll specialists to select every employee and managers to select direct reports, so these non-HR roles receive sensitive PII without field-level authorization.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: The payroll_specialist branch returns the unrestricted onboarding-task queryset. Payroll users can enumerate and open every employee's task, exposing descriptions, status, dates, reviewer identity, and review notes despite their role being limited to payroll workflows.

Payroll specialists receive the unrestricted HRRequest queryset and are also authorized to see internal comments. This exposes all benefits, time-off, equipment, and general HR request bodies and internal notes rather than limiting payroll users to payroll-related requests.

The payroll export writes employee and manager display names to CSV without neutralizing leading formula characters. Users can update their own first and last names through ProfileUpdateForm, so a value beginning with =, +, -, or @ will be interpreted as a formula when HR or payroll opens the export in spreadsheet software.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

extra.message: The onboarding export writes self-editable employee display names directly to CSV without formula neutralization. A malicious name beginning with a spreadsheet formula prefix is executed or evaluated when a privileged user opens the downloaded file.

cwe: CWE-1236: Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File
